title: All Work and No Pay/Quotes
summary:
"As your loyal bodyguard, I'll do anything I can to help."
- Santiago to Sophie Casterwil

"The uniforms are nothing if not striking."
-LeBlanche to Sophie Casterwill and Lok Lambert, while they are working in a hotel 

"Madam, your dog is attempting to assail me!"
-LeBlanche to hotel customer 

"Nice moves for a young pup."
-LeBlanche to Lok Lambert

"I think you know exactly what you're looking for."
-Klaus to Dante Vale

"I tend to be a very serious fellow. All of my friends tell me so"
-Klaus to Lok Lambert
